rationale: Shiza brings hands-on expertise in deploying custom ML models and robotics systems, while Grady has 15+ years navigating FDA regulatory pathways and commercializing AI-guided medical devices through VA and DoD channels—two complementary skill sets for building regulated hardware-software products. Both share a conviction that emerging technologies (humanoid robotics, rapid-acting mental health treatments) represent fundamentally new platforms worth building on, and both operate at the intersection of technical depth and real-world deployment challenges.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Grady Hannah — he's built and commercialized FDA-cleared AI wearables for the VA and DoD, and you're shipping applied ML in robotics; your complementary expertise in deployment, regulation, and emerging platforms could spark a useful conversation.
